svg.title: Plot 251
svg.desc: Scatter plot of z against x and y, colored by speed, with scatter plot of z against x and y, in 3D. x from −30 to 30, y from 0 to 65, z from −35 to 35. 60,000 points. It is animated; this describes it at rest.

svg.style: font: 400 14px "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; fill: rgb(229, 231, 235); stroke: rgb(148, 163, 184); stroke-width: 1px; paint-order: normal; color: rgb(48, 52, 59); opacity: 1; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; position: static;
